scripts.wasm:build: rm -rf src/engine-wasm/pkg && cd ../../engine && wasm-pack build hosts/wasm --target web --out-dir ../../../apps/lopsy-web/src/engine-wasm/pkg
scripts.wasm:build:wgpu: rm -rf src/engine-wasm/pkg-wgpu && cd ../../engine && wasm-pack build hosts/wasm --target web --out-dir ../../../apps/lopsy-web/src/engine-wasm/pkg-wgpu -- --features wgpu
scripts.wasm:build:dev: rm -rf src/engine-wasm/pkg && cd ../../engine && wasm-pack build hosts/wasm --target web --dev --out-dir ../../../apps/lopsy-web/src/engine-wasm/pkg
scripts.wasm:build:noopt: rm -rf src/engine-wasm/pkg && cd ../../engine && wasm-pack build hosts/wasm --release --no-opt --target web --out-dir ../../../apps/lopsy-web/src/engine-wasm/pkg
scripts.wasm:test:wgpu: cd ../../engine && cargo test -p lopsy-engine --features native && cargo test -p lopsy-cli
scripts.build: npm run wasm:build && npm run wasm:build:wgpu && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.test:e2e:preview: npm run build && LOPSY_PREVIEW=1 playwright test --project=preview --retries=0
scripts.parity:record: rm -rf .parity/baseline && PARITY_OUT=.parity/baseline playwright test composition-koi-fish composition-shapes --project=chromium --retries=0 --workers=1
scripts.parity:check: rm -rf .parity/current && PARITY_OUT=.parity/current playwright test composition-koi-fish composition-shapes --project=chromium --retries=0 --workers=1 && node scripts/parity-compare.mjs .parity/baseline .parity/current
scripts.lint: eslint src && node scripts/check-pixel-debt.mjs && node scripts/check-gl-debt.mjs
